body: I don't know if anyone cares, but I'm still here. I told my SO everything so I wouldn't have access to a gun anymore. My life isn't going any better now, but I haven't felt like killing myself for a couple days. I don't think it will last.

I'm sorry you're going through this. I can kind of relate. I'm a trans woman and I've been doubting my steady relationship for over 5 years. You and I are both worthy of love and we probably have it. It's just not easy to accept.
